cards.title: Lambda Handler
cards.description: Keep handlers small, idempotent, and safe to retry.

cards.title: DynamoDB Key Design
cards.code:
PK: USER#123
SK: PROFILE

cards.title: S3 Presigned Upload
cards.code:
const command = new PutObjectCommand({ Bucket, Key, ContentType });
const url = await getSignedUrl(s3, command, { expiresIn: 300 });
cards.description: Use short-lived URLs and validate content type and size.

idempotency keys
